intent: Establish the Java 21 Maven foundation and implement resilient resolved JSONL store snapshots
Implement the Java 21 Maven foundation and resilient resolved JSONL store snapshot

name: JsonlStoreReader
role: Builds a deterministic current-state view from FluencyLoop JSONL files.
conditions: It continues after malformed lines, reports their source and line number, and keeps unknown shapes unkeyed.

name: StoreLayout
conditions: It sorts repository-relative paths so resolution order is reproducible.

name: StoreRecordIdentity
role: Maps supported record types to stable identities.
conditions: A later record with the same identity replaces the earlier effective value.

subject: Runtime coverage agent
why: JaCoCo 0.8.14 supports the local JDK 25; older 0.8.12 emits unsupported-class instrumentation warnings.

title: Resolve append-only store records without losing damaged evidence
why: The reader isolates malformed JSONL lines as diagnostics, resolves known records by stable identity in deterministic order, and preserves unknown records as unkeyed evidence.
alternative: Fail fast or discard unfamiliar records — rejected because a local damaged line or a future record type must not hide otherwise usable evidence.

title: Promote resilient local inspection
why: The malformed-line diagnostic policy is a project-wide rule for local evidence inspection, not a one-off parser detail.
alternative: Treat malformed local input as a fatal inspection error — rejected because it hides usable evidence.
